scenarios.name: Bull: AI Memory Supercycle & Structural HBM Moat
assumptions: HBM3e 12-high and early HBM4 achieve >25% global market share on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra and AMD MI350 platforms with gross margins exceeding 52%.
PC and smartphone AI content inflects aggressively to 16GB-32GB DRAM baseline, creating severe industry wafer deficit and driving mid-teens DDR5 ASP increases.
Enterprise SSD revenue expands >100% YoY as high-density 60TB+ QLC SSDs capture massive hyperscaler data lake share from mechanical hard drives.

scenarios.name: Base: Controlled Disciplined Oligopoly Expansion
assumptions: Full fiscal year 2027 revenue crosses $52.5B with company gross margin averaging 43.5% across DRAM and NAND.
Calendar 2026/2027 HBM capacity remains 100% sold out under firm supply contracts; 1-gamma EUV DRAM transition proceeds smoothly.
Samsung enters 12-high HBM3e supply chains with modest volumes, stabilizing industry pricing without triggering price competition.

scenarios.name: Bear: Cyclical Capex Digestion & Pricing Pressure
assumptions: Hyperscalers initiate a multi-quarter AI hardware procurement pause in H2 FY2027, tempering server DRAM bit shipments.
Samsung aggressively expands 1b DRAM wafer output from Pyeongtaek Fab P4, compressing standard DDR5 blended ASPs by 20%.
Advanced packaging yield losses during early HBM4 16-high transition compress company gross margin down to 31%.
